notes: Route: robots.txt permissive (Allow: /, Disallow only /search/ and /rating.php*), names sitemaps. https://www.antena3.ro/sitemap.xml (200, 47KB) is an index of monthly flat urlsets sitemap-articles-YYYY-MM.xml; fetched 2026-09 (200, 2.5MB) and 2026-10 (200, 2.2MB) - two requests cover the whole window, no recursion. Every <url> carries <loc>, an amphtml xhtml:link, and <lastmod> with full timestamp. KEY: <lastmod> is the publication time, not the edit time - sampled articles match page JSON-LD NewsArticle datePublished to the minute (2026-09-30T23:45:00 vs 23:45:01; another sample 23:45 vs 23:42, 3 min drift, same date) while dateModified is later (10-01 on one of them), so lastmod is the right field. Listed date = date-part of <lastmod> (Bucharest local). Excluded /videos-antena3-cnn/ video pages, kept article pages only. Result: 3724 unique URLs, 31/31 days, 09-30=121, 10-10=91, 10-20=150, min 62 (10-18). Ran in ~1.4s, 2 requests. Verified 4 random sample re-fetches: all HTTP 200, 11050/13238/12434/11377 chars of visible text (min 1500 bar easily met), page JSON-LD datePublished within 1 day of listed date on all 4 (three exact, one off by exactly 1 day). No duplicates, all dates in window.
